Good to know

Common questions

How much does event videography cost?
Event videography is usually quoted by the hour or as a package. Australian pricing varies with coverage and edit length. Requesting quotes is the best way to see real pricing for your event.
How far in advance should I book?
For weddings and peak-season events, popular photographers and videographers are often booked six to twelve months ahead. For smaller events a few weeks can be enough. The earlier you enquire, the more choice you have.
